en.headline: Tourism Board extends Halloween night bus and tram rides to six days
en.dek: Costumed riders who spend at partner outlets can collect free night rides on selected weekends from 17 October through Halloween.
body: The Hong Kong Tourism Board said on Tuesday it is widening the night rides tied to its first Hong Kong Halloween Month, adding Sunday dates and Halloween itself to the original Saturday schedule.

The board said the Citybus sightseeing-bus and party-tram night rides will now run on six days: 17 and 18 October, 24 and 25 October, and 30 and 31 October. The earlier plan covered three Saturday nights. Sightseeing buses are scheduled every 45 minutes, with extra boarding points at Statue Square in Central, Langham Place in Mong Kok, Kai Tak Sports Park and Tsim Sha Tsui Centre. Party trams are scheduled once an hour.

The board said residents and visitors in Halloween costume who spend a set amount at designated outlets of partner groups — Hongkong Land, Kai Tak Sports Park, Langham Place, and Sino Group properties including Tsim Sha Tsui Centre, Empire Centre and China Hong Kong City — can collect a free-ride voucher at the partners' redemption points. Places are limited and issued on a first-come, first-served basis.

The board is also running a social-media prize activity during the month. It said people who post a photo or short video taken in Hong Kong that shows the Halloween atmosphere, with the specified tags, on Instagram, Xiaohongshu or Weibo, will be in the draw for gifts.

zh.headline: 旅發局擴大萬聖月夜間巴士及電車 增至六天
zh.dek: 盛裝人士在合作商戶消費達指定金額，可於10月17日起指定周末換領免費夜間乘車體驗，涵蓋萬聖節當日。
body: 香港旅遊發展局星期二表示，今年首辦的「香港萬聖月」夜間乘車安排會擴大，在原定星期六以外，加入星期日及萬聖節當日。
旅發局稱，城巴觀光巴士及派對電車的限定夜間體驗，由原本三個星期六晚，延伸至10月17及18日、24及25日，以及30及31日，合共六天。觀光巴士每45分鐘一班，並在中環皇后像廣場、旺角朗豪坊、啟德體育園及尖沙咀中心增設上客點。派對電車則每小時一班。
旅發局表示，市民及旅客穿上萬聖節裝扮，並在指定合作夥伴商戶消費滿指定金額，可到兌換點換領免費乘車券。合作夥伴包括置地公司、啟德體育園、朗豪坊，以及信和集團旗下尖沙咀中心、帝國中心及中港城。名額有限，先到先得。
旅發局又稱，活動期間會在社交平台設有獎環節。市民及旅客在Instagram、小紅書或微博上載於香港拍攝、展示萬聖節氣氛的相片或短片，並加上指定標註，即有機會參加抽獎。
